ideas.title: Start from wherever you are
ideas.body: Journey Setup asks a few plain questions, one at a time: about to start, going up in dose steps, on your maintenance dose, coming down or taking a break. Already partway through? Say which step you're on and how many doses you've had, and GLPMGR carries on from there.

ideas.title: Bring your doses from another app
ideas.body: Import the spreadsheet (CSV) your old app exports and your doses come with you, read on your iPhone and never added twice. Or add earlier doses a line at a time, or fill them in from your dose steps.

ideas.title: Something Changed?
ideas.body: Going up, coming down, reaching your maintenance dose, taking a break, starting again or finishing: log it in plain English. It's on your timeline, weight charts and doctor's report, and your schedule follows only if you say so.

ideas.title: Current and previous doses
ideas.body: From the day your dose changes, it's your current dose and the one before is your previous dose. Each dose step shows Done, Now or Next.

ideas.title: Doses on set days
ideas.body: Take doses on set days of the week, each with its own time, for example Monday 8:00 and Thursday 20:00.

ideas.title: Encouragement, if you'd like it
ideas.body: Off until you turn it on: milestones for what you log (never your weight), a garden that grows with the days you log and never wilts, and streaks for logging with a rest day each week. Never for doses.

ideas.title: Maintenance Mode
ideas.body: Maintenance Tools is now Maintenance Mode: once you reach your goal, see your recent average next to a range you choose.

ideas.title: Muscle Support
ideas.body: Your average protein and your strength sessions this week, from Apple Health, side by side. No targets unless you set your own.

ideas.title: Appetite beside your weight
ideas.body: Your check-in's appetite answers week by week under your weight, and each check-in compared with last time.

ideas.title: Your own range on the glucose chart
ideas.body: Enter the range your diabetes team gave you and see it as a band on the blood glucose chart. Nothing is filled in for you.

ideas.title: Food names and +500 ml on Apple Watch and widgets
ideas.body: See what you logged for protein by name, and add 500 ml of water in one tap, from your wrist and your Home Screen.

ideas.title: Help with pictures
ideas.body: Help inside the app, with screenshots: tap ? on Today, Journey, Symptoms or Dosing Schedule.
